_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Every field can also come from env vars (SABNZBD_HOST, SABNZBD_PORT, SABNZBD_HTTPS, SABNZBD_API_KEY, SABNZBD_URL_BASE, SABNZBD_VERIFY_SSL, SABNZBD_TIMEOUT), which override the file. Create the API key in SABnzbd under Config > General > API Key (grants full control). host/port/url_base together form the base URL; if SABnzbd is at http://nas:8080/sabnzbd use url_base="/sabnzbd". API key normally comes from 1Password (Gregory vault item 'SABnzbd API Key').
